# 未來星宿劫千佛名經

**ID:** T0448b
**Volume:** T14
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0448b

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The second recension (T448b) of the future-aeon thousand-Buddha-names text, preserved only in the CBETA edition. The source text carries the alternative title 未來星宿劫千佛名經(一名集諸佛大功德山) and the colophon note 開元拾遺附梁錄 ("appended to the Liáng records in the Kāiyuán supplement"), placing it bibliographically within the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù* 開元釋教錄's supplementary appendix. Together with T448a ([KR6i0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0026)), T446a/b ([KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)–[KR6i0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0023)), and T447a/b ([KR6i0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0024)–[KR6i0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0025)), this text completes the "Three Aeons, Three Thousand Buddhas" system used in Chinese Buddhist liturgical confession.

**Abstract**

T448b is the less-attested recension of the future-aeon list; its preservation only in CBETA (without major canon edition witnesses) parallels T447b and T446b, suggesting a coherent "b" transmission stream separate from the major printed-canon "a" recensions. See [KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)–[KR6i0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0026) for context.
